messages:
tess_fin: heads up 12: invoice INV-2028-0077 for Borealis shows a -$3,120 "auto adjustment" line. our commit reconciles to $62,400 but invoice total is $59,280.
neil_eng: can you paste the invoice line?
tess_fin: link: https://invoices.redwood.example/INV-2028-0077 . line reads 'AUTO_ADJUST: -3120'. no manual credit requests found.
billing-bot: billing-check: invoice INV-2028-0077 matched to commit C-BOR-2028Q1. detected ADJ_CODE=AUTO_ADJUST amount=-3120; origin=BillGen(v2).
sam_sales: Borealis did a capacity scale-down on 2028-02-20 (reduced reserved GPUs by 2 mid-quarter). Might be linked.
neil_eng: scale-down should trigger a single proration event, not this code. I'll pull the billgen logs.
tess_fin: invoice is currently in AR hold state. do not collect until resolved.
neil_eng: log excerpt:
```
2028-03-14T05:48:01Z BILLGEN INFO invoice=INV-2028-0077 commit=C-BOR-2028Q1 calc_base=62400 adjustments=[{code:AUTO_PRORATE,amount:-1560},{code:AUTO_PRORATE,amount:-1560}] total=59280
```

sam_sales: oh that looks like proration was applied twice. Borealis only had one scale event.
neil_eng: bug: when a scale action spans the billing window boundary and the migration handler and the scale handler both emit proration events, we double-count. ticket BG-9401 opened.
tess_fin: estimated impact across customers?
neil_eng: running a quick query to find invoices with two AUTO_PRORATE entries in same invoice batch.
billing-bot: bg-query: found 11 invoices in March batch with duplicate AUTO_PRORATE entries. list attached to BG-9401.
ceo_cust_ops: what's our remediation plan and ETA? this affects committed revenue recognition.
tess_fin: proposal: 1) hotfix BillGen to dedupe proration events for a given commit window. 2) regenerate affected invoices and send corrected statements. 3) for customers already paid, issue short-term receivable adjustments and notify them.
sam_sales: Borealis prefers a corrected invoice rather than sudden charge. they asked for an explanation and an apology note.
neil_eng: hotfix PR ready, requesting review. can merge and deploy after sign-off. patch is simple: add event dedupe by (commit_id, proration_window_hash).
billing-bot: CI: billgen/hotfix BG-9401 test results: unit+integration pass.
tess_fin: finance to approve regen for the 11 invoices once deploy is confirmed. we also need a short customer note template.
eil_eng: deploy scheduled in 30m. will publish deploy logs here.
billing-bot: regen-queue: invoices tagged BG-9401 queued for regeneration after deploy. regen ETA 2028-03-15T03:00:00Z.
tess_fin: approved. finance will reconcile regenerated totals and prepare adjustment memos for accounting.
ceo_cust_ops: ensure we include a goodwill token for customers who already paid and express frustration. pre-approve up to $500 per affected account, escalate above that.
sam_sales: will draft customer email: short apology, explanation (duplicate proration bug), corrected invoice attached, timeline for refund if paid.
neil_eng: deploy complete. logs:
```
2028-03-14T06:12:34Z DEPLOY INFO billgen v2.1.3 hotfix BG-9401 applied
2028-03-14T06:13:10Z DEPLOY INFO migration:dedupe enabled
```

billing-bot: regen started for BG-9401 tagged invoices. progress: 11/11 queued.
tess_fin: once regen finishes finance will post reconciliation here and release holds as appropriate. thanks team.
sam_sales: Borealis replied: "thanks for handling this quickly, please send corrected invoice and we'll review." :pray:
